text:
emma: hi all, emma here — first day on eng-ml! :wave: quick problem: i click Grafana link and Okta returns 'You are not authorized to access this application'. same for Datadog. who owns observability invites?

nishant: welcome emma :tada: i handle observability for ML teams. paste your okta email and i'll start the add. also check spam for invites.

emma: emma.park@redwood.com. no invites yet. tried incognito and cleared cookies.

okta-bot: okta-bot logged failed app assignment for emma.park@redwood.com to "Redwood Datadog". Created ticket IDP-3629.

claire: cc @nishant — for Grafana i usually send an infra invite (viewer). For Datadog you need team assignment (inference-observability). If you need Sentry also, security approval will be required.

nishant: creating INFRA-3081 to add emma to Grafana viewers and Datadog team. infra-bot will post invite. Estimated ETA ~4h for identity sync.

infra-bot: infra-bot sent Grafana invite to emma.park@redwood.com (expires in 7 days). Datadog team add queued.

emma: got Grafana invite and accepted — can view most dashboards. can't find "inference-costs" though. search returns nothing.

claire: folder ACLs control some dashboards. i'll add you to infra folder view. if you still can't find it, ping me with the exact dashboard slug.

nishant: Datadog sync completed, you should have read access now.

emma: Datadog works! i can see the cost dashboard and p95 graphs. thanks everyone for the quick help :raised_hands: will ping if i need edit permissions or pager routing.

claire: welcome aboard! added a short note to the onboarding checklist: Grafana invites usually <1h, Datadog team sync up to 4h, Sentry requires security approval and 2FA on first login.

emma: perfect, thanks :heart:
